name: rn-starter-skills
description: React Native skills for Claude Code: machine setup and new apps, ticket analysis and building, screens from designs, mocks to a real API, Maestro E2E flows, EAS release setup and gated production releases.

plugins.name: rn-starter
plugins.description: Seven skills: rn-starter (clean machine to running app), rn-feature (ticket analysis and building, against design and API), rn-ui (screens from text, screenshots or Figma), rn-api-connect (mocks to a real API from OpenAPI, sign-in), rn-e2e (Maestro flows per requirement), rn-release-setup (a dev and a production app on EAS, store credentials, the release gate) and rn-release (production releases a release manager approves by merging).
